title: Bhutan Tour Package from Jaigaon
highlights: Admire the breathtaking beauty of Bhutan with our Bhutan Tour Package from Jaigaon, featuring ancient monasteries and stunning landscapes.
Explore Bhutan’s ‘Palace of Great Happiness’ - Punakha Dzong, where centuries-old murals and sacred relics tell the story of a vibrant past.
Marvel at one of the world’s largest Buddha statues, standing at 177 feet and offering sweeping views of the Thimphu Valley.
Witness the spiritual aura of Tiger’s Nest Monastery in Paro, an 8th-century monastery clinging to a cliffside, offering unmatched panoramic views.
overview:
About the destinations:
Bhutan, the Land of the Thunder Dragon, offers a mesmerising journey through its untouched landscapes and rich cultural heritage. Begin your adventure in Phuntsholing, a vibrant border town that serves as the gateway to Bhutan. Explore its unique blend of Bhutanese and Indian cultures, making it the perfect start for your Bhutan tour from Jaigaon.


Next, head to Thimphu, the bustling capital of Bhutan, where tradition meets modernity. Visit iconic landmarks like the National Memorial Chorten and Tashichho Dzong, or take a stroll through its charming markets and cafes. Thimphu’s cultural richness makes it a must-visit on any Bhutan Tour Package from Jaigaon.


Punakha is known for its breathtaking landscapes and historical sites, such as the magnificent Punakha Dzong, located at the confluence of two rivers. The peaceful surroundings offer the perfect respite amidst Bhutan's scenic beauty.


End your journey in Paro, home to the iconic Tiger’s Nest Monastery and numerous sacred sites. Explore the spiritual heart of Bhutan by visiting Kyichu Lhakhang or simply enjoy the serene atmosphere of this picturesque valley town.


Each destination in Bhutan has its own charm, making your journey through the kingdom an unforgettable experience.

know_before_you_go: Images are for representation purpose only.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.

Indians must pay the Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) of Rs 1200 per person/per night. Children below 5 years are exempted from SDF, while kids between 6 and 12 years of age, will get 50% concession.
To obtain entry in Bhutan, Indian tourists must carry their passports with a minimum 6 months validity and make the payment of SDF.
Plastic has been banned since 1999 in Bhutan, therefore, it is advised to carry plastic/plastic items.
Keep your arms and legs covered while visiting a Dzong (fortress-monastery).
Ask for permission from the attending authority before taking any photos or videos inside places like monasteries.
In Bhutan, Tuesday is ‘Dry Day’. This means locals don’t drink alcohol on Tuesday. So it would be respectful to avoid alcohol on Tuesdays too.
It’s illegal for tobacco to be sold in Bhutan. Tourists can bring cigarettes into the country, but can only smoke them in designated places.
Bhutan does not have a micro (or nano) SIM card. So check your mobile device for SIM compatibility before visiting Bhutan.
Ask your local guide to help you purchase a SIM on arrival, as Bhutan supports 2 networks: B-Mobile SIM and TashiCell.
Credit cards are widely accepted in major cities and tourist areas. However, it is recommended to carry some cash.
The official currency in Bhutan is the Bhutanese Ngultrum (BTN). It is advisable to exchange currency at banks or authorised exchange bureaus.

Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

Rescheduling Policy for Private (Standard & Deluxe Package) & Group Bookings: 1) If rescheduling is made 7 days after the booking date till 15 days prior to the date of travel then 30.0% of the total tour cost will be charged as rescheduling fees. | 2) If rescheduling is made 0 days to 15 days before the date of travel then 100.0% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. | 3) If bookings are made 15 days before the date of travel no rescheduling & modifications will be made.
Rescheduling Policy for Private (Super Deluxe) & Hotel Specific Bookings: No modification or rescheduling will be catered. A standard cancellation policy will be applicable for such cases.

Cancellation After Rescheduling: Clients who reschedule their tours or treks but later decide to cancel will be subject to our standard cancellation policy. Any rescheduling fees paid will be non-refundable.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Siliguri | Transfer to Phuntsholing | Leisure Day
days.desc: Upon arrival in Siliguri, begin your journey with a transfer to Phuntsholing, the gateway to Bhutan. Check in at your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You can take a stroll around the town, explore local markets, or unwind after your journey. You can also visit the Amo Chhu Crocodile Breeding Centre to observe these fascinating reptiles up close or take a leisurely walk by the scenic Torsa River. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.desc: Check out of the hotel and visit the immigration office to obtain the travel permit before being driven to Thimphu. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and explore Thimphu on your own. You can visit the Ludrong Memorial Garden, where you can stroll through beautifully landscaped gardens with colourful flowers. You can also visit the Royal Botanical Garden, home to a diverse array of plant species, perfect for a relaxing walk amid stunning natural beauty. Later, return to the hotel on your own.

days.title: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, board the transfer for a sightseeing tour of Thimphu. Visit Buddha Dordenma, a towering statue offering panoramic views of the city. Explore the National Memorial Chorten, a prominent religious structure where locals come to pray, followed by a visit to Tashichho Dzong, Bhutan’s majestic fortress-monastery. Take time to visit the Folk Heritage Museum to learn about Bhutanese traditions, and head to other attractions before getting transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Punakha | Punakha Sightseeing
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get driven to the hotel in Punakha to check in. Upon arrival, visit the magnificent Punakha Dzong, a historical fortress set at the confluence of the Mo Chhu and Pho Chhu rivers. Then, head to the peaceful Chimi Lhakhang Temple, known for its significance as a fertility temple. After exploring these iconic sites, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.desc: Travel from Punakha to Paro, enjoying the serene views along the way. Upon reaching Paro, check in at your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You may explore the charming streets of Paro, known for its picturesque setting and peaceful atmosphere, or relax at your hotel. Use this downtime to unwind and get ready for the next day’s adventures, which include exploring Paro’s historical treasures and Bhutan’s famous Tiger’s Nest Monastery.

days.title: Visit to Ta Dzong & Rinpung Dzong | Tiger's Nest Monastery Trek
days.desc: Begin the day by getting transferred to visit Ta Dzong, Bhutan’s National Museum, followed by a visit to Rinpung Dzong, an iconic structure offering insights into Bhutanese history. In the afternoon, embark on the famous trek to the Tiger’s Nest Monastery, perched on a cliff 900 metres above the valley floor. The challenging trek rewards you with one of Bhutan’s most incredible sights, and the serene atmosphere of this sacred site is an unforgettable experience. Later, return to the hotel.

days.title: Paro Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: On this day, explore Paro’s cultural and spiritual landmarks, including Kyichu Lhakhang, one of Bhutan’s oldest and most revered temples. Continue your journey to Drukgyel Dzong, a historical fortress offering a glimpse into Bhutan’s past, with breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. Adventure seekers can also catch a stunning view of Jhomolhari, the "Bride of Kangchenjunga," one of Bhutan’s most sacred peaks. End the day by getting dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Phuntsholing | Leisure Day
days.desc: Check out of the hotel in Paro and get driven to Phuntsholing. Upon arrival, check in and relax for a while.
